_notes.format: Keys are single artist tokens exactly as they appear in index.html tiles (<span class="art">), the ALBUMS array and feats.json. A tile artist string such as "PIZZA, Леонид Агутин" must be split on ", " and each token mapped; the "*" foreign-agent marker is stripped before lookup and re-attached after. Keys starting with "_" are not artists.
_notes.source: Every Cyrillic token was checked against Spotify on 2026-09-12 via the og:description of a track page in the catalogue (curl https://open.spotify.com/track/<data-id>). Latin tokens are already the international name and map to themselves.
_notes.kept_cyrillic: Spotify lists these artists in Cyrillic on the international catalogue, so the display name stays Cyrillic (the same string an English-speaking listener sees on Spotify): Дора, МОТ, Андрей Катиков, Мэйби Бэйби, Лера Литвинцева, Бондарь, Оли, Оля Краснова, Папион, катя милтей, тима ищет свет, qantreez x челс. Common press romanizations are given in _romanization for optional one-time use in parentheses on a track lead; do not use them as the display name.
_notes.canon: build_who_mixed.CANON folds "Dima Bilan" into "Дима Билан" for RU hub grouping. In EN both map to "Dima Bilan"; group by the EN value so he stays one section.
_notes.dora_note: Дора is widely written "Dora" in Western press, but Spotify keeps "Дора"; kept Cyrillic per the Spotify rule.
_notes.mot_note: МОТ is Cyrillic on Spotify (looks like Latin MOT but is not); kept Cyrillic.
_notes.katikov_note: Андрей Катиков stays Cyrillic as a display name (Spotify), but in story prose (notes.json) he is written Andrey Katikov, as in the RU stories he is a producer named in running text.
_notes.skryptonite_note: Spotify's international spelling is Skryptonite (not Scriptonite).
